differences.openwhisper: 'Use for meetings' saves meeting_speech_separate and meeting_asr_source remote (use_remote_for_meetings) and opens Meeting voice; 'Use for dictation' selects the Remote computer engine.
differences.fiorivoce: 'Use for meetings' opens Settings on Meeting voice (useForMeetingsRequested has no receiver), where the paired host is chosen and confirmed for meeting audio. 'Use for dictation' saves the remote model selection and reloads (remote_feature.cpp); the page's half is pinned by 'settings page pairs with a host and lists the device', the wiring has no test.
differences.reason: A dictation preference does not authorize sending meeting audio to another computer: each remote meeting route needs its own confirmation of the named host.

differences.openwhisper: The records-location tile keeps new records on the host automatically and describes it so.
differences.fiorivoce: The shipped RecordSync reports manual_transfers(), so the tile and its notes use the manual-transfer wording ('Copy or move existing dictations…', 'Choose the transfer button when you are ready.'); OpenWhisper's wording shows only without it and is pinned there.
differences.reason: Record sharing is explicit and per session.

differences.openwhisper: 'Allow paired computers to manage MCP' lets a paired computer change the host's MCP settings.
differences.fiorivoce: With a PeerMcpSession (the app) the tile is 'Grant session MCP control to one paired computer': it asks which computer, confirms and calls grant_mcp_session for a 15-minute read-only local listener.
differences.reason: Granting one paired device access does not authorize changes to the host's settings or a reusable credential.

differences.openwhisper: A pairing request waiting for the host's owner keeps its worker thread waiting after Settings closes, until the host answers or the request ends.
differences.fiorivoce: Closing the Remote engine page cancels a pairing request still waiting.
differences.reason: A request whose page is gone has nowhere to show its code or its result.
